consequence.statement: Existing PolicyException objects stay stored as v2beta1 until they are rewritten. Operators must run a storage version migration and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v2beta1.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, rewrite all policyexceptions.kyverno.io objects so they are stored as v2. Then remove v2beta1 from the CRD's status.storedVersions.

assertion.statement: In 1.13.0 the policyexceptions.kyverno.io CRD's storage version moves from v2beta1 to v2, so existing PolicyException objects need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before a later release removes v2beta1.
